purpose: Source-field accounting and a versioned restricted consumer, not alpha research or universal vendor certification.
allowed_inputs: their dictionaries and existing source explanations
only 2025-12-01 rows of the two already-used 2025 ETF CSVs; whole-file bytes may be hashed
existing single-day and upstream audit evidence
quantity_check: For every quote event compare cum_volume to sums of positive recorded tick quantities with source labels strictly before, and before-or-at, that label. Preserve all mismatches, phases and same-time records. Final-day equality does not certify intraday equality or units.
price_check: Compare quote last_price_x10000 to the latest recorded tick price at-or-before the same source label. Tied prints retain delivered trade_seq. Record exact ties and no-prior-print cases; do not infer exchange ordering. The documented divisor 10000 is only a declared-price-scale hypothesis when comparing legacy decimal OHLC, not independent currency certification.
amount_check: Report quote cum_amount and sum(tick price_x10000 * raw quantity)/10000 as a conditional dimensional check only. No fitted multiplier, lot conversion or missing trade amount fabrication.

minute_check.rules: All four are fixed boundary accounting scenarios, not selectable candidates. For every delivered legacy row on the fixed day, retain raw OHLC and volume, tick counts/sums/OHLC and no-print indicators. Compare within [09:30,11:30) and [13:00,14:57) only when the complete 60-second interval lies within that phase; boundary rows remain in ledger with out-of-scope status. No correlation-based shift, selecting a best bucket, interpolation, forward fill or adoption of these scenarios as vendor truth.

consumer_v1: Read-only source-label lookup. Require a same-phase checkpoint, original ordered events, valid_from <= t < valid_until, and clamp effective end at the declared phase boundary. Reject reversed/empty/unknown intervals and non-continuous phases. No backward filling, no cross-phase carry, no replacing invalid events with older states, no terminal extension. Preserve raw data and a separate disposition ledger. This is a consumer restriction, not an upstream DataHub repair or live as-of certification.
outputs: all quote/tick reconciliation rows and phase summaries
complete legacy minute boundary scenario ledger and summaries
versioned consumer interval dispositions and fixed boundary probes
report with explicit unresolved questions and stopping decision
stop_rule: Complete this finite accounting once. No model or shifted-bucket search follows; unresolved publication time, vendor originals and IOPV remain usage limits. A failed vendor reconstruction cannot be rescued by choosing a favorable scenario.
